title: Pocket Planes optimization · Evan Diewald
finding: Optimizes trips, fleets and airport portfolios using calibrated observations, value iteration and a constrained portfolio model. Inspected the README, portfolio model, value iteration and toy MDP at commit 6f661d1eac4932ca51e9f8450255cd8ff09cee31.
applied: Applied reproducible random experiments and separate evaluation seeds. Pocket Planes profit, airport population and delivery bonuses are not assumed to apply to Pocket Trains.

title: Pocket Planes agent simulation · kcelebi
finding: An agent-based Processing simulation separating agents, game state and actions. Inspected its implementation: several optimizer classes are placeholders and flight time is hardcoded, so it is not a verified global optimizer.
applied: Useful separation of jobs, vehicles and time for future calibrated simulation; the present tool makes no vehicle-dispatch or earnings claim.

title: Pocket Planes 2.0 route calculator
finding: A route-calculator project derived from earlier community calculators. Its route utilities check range, distance and airport eligibility; this is not a complete network-layout solver.
applied: Applied the principle that feasibility must be checked independently of the score. Train choice remains separate from this engine-agnostic ownership model.

title: Pocket Planes distance calculations
finding: Documents wraparound distance calculations for a changed Pocket Planes map. Geometry and version assumptions can change preferred routes.
applied: Stress-tested the eight provisional Pocket Trains distances. No free-flight or wraparound connections were added to the fixed rail map.

title: Recombination: spanning trees and connected partitions
finding: ReCom explores connected partitions by merging neighboring regions and cutting a random spanning tree.
applied: Inspired connected two- and three-railroad repartitions on the track line graph, with a weighted planning cap. Our asymmetric annealing proposals are heuristic optimization, not stationary posterior sampling.

title: Pocket Trains game implementations inspected
finding: Search also found this game project and TheIceCreamBear/PocketTrains, a clone. Neither was verified as a complete global track-layout solver.
applied: No external project code was copied or executed. Layouts and scores here are independently computed from the supplied tracker map.

title: Pocket Trains official App Store version history
finding: Version 1.9 introduced Metro Electric and Petabyte Electric with electrified tracks and zero-fuel operation. Later notes describe engine/fuel-car management fixes. This version history does not independently validate the supplied map or its prices.
applied: Kept track distance as an explicit routing proxy instead of claiming literal fuel consumption for every engine. Vehicle speed, capacity, electrification and operating costs remain outside the engine-agnostic objective.
